narr: Storms developed along a stationary boundary in northwestern Oklahoma into the Texas panhandle during the afternoon and evening of May 31st, and lingered into the early morning hours of June 1st. Slow storm motions led to very heavy rainfall and flooding in some locations, with a few reports of severe wind also received.
ev: Multiple roads closed due to creeks overrunning their banks.
lsr: MULTIPLE ROADS CLOSED DUE TO CREEKS OVERRUNING THEIR BANKS IN THE CLINTON/ARAPAHO AREAS, WITH HEAVY RAIN CONTINUING ACROSS CUSTER COUNTY.
